sql:
-- ETH-anchored closed Uniswap cycles (V2/V3/hookless V4, 2-5 legs, distinct pools), by ordered pool path,
-- 30 days to 2026-10-26 20:39:32 UTC (fixed, so a rerun returns the same rows).
-- ETH (V4 currency 0x0) and WETH are one asset, at the anchor and between legs: a path that starts at V4
-- native ETH and ends at V2/V3 WETH (or the reverse) closes. V4 legs carry the pool id and the PoolKey fee and
-- tickSpacing (PoolManager Initialize); V3 legs the factory fee and tickSpacing. Profit is gross, in USD at the
-- dex.trades price; a tx whose profit is > 50% of its largest leg's USD is a pricing error (suspect_usd).
-- clean_arbs / med_profit_usd / max_profit_usd: the arbs with a positive, correctly priced profit.
WITH v3p AS (
  SELECT pool, fee, tickSpacing FROM uniswap_v3_ethereum.factory_evt_poolcreated
),
v4i AS (
  SELECT id, currency0, currency1, fee, tickSpacing, hooks FROM uniswap_v4_ethereum.poolmanager_evt_initialize
),
v4s AS (
  SELECT evt_tx_hash, evt_index, id FROM uniswap_v4_ethereum.poolmanager_evt_swap
  WHERE evt_block_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-26 20:39:32' AND evt_block_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-26 20:39:32'
),
t AS (
  SELECT d.tx_hash, d.evt_index, d.version,
         CASE WHEN d.version = '4' THEN s.id ELSE d.project_contract_address END AS pool,
         CASE d.version WHEN '2' THEN 3000 WHEN '3' THEN p.fee WHEN '4' THEN i.fee END AS fee,
         CASE d.version WHEN '2' THEN 0 WHEN '3' THEN p.tickSpacing WHEN '4' THEN i.tickSpacing END AS spacing,
         i.hooks,
         d.version = '4' AND 0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2 IN (i.currency0, i.currency1) AS v4_weth,
         CASE WHEN d.token_sold_address = 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 THEN 0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2 ELSE d.token_sold_address END AS sold,
         CASE WHEN d.token_bought_address = 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 THEN 0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2 ELSE d.token_bought_address END AS bought,
         d.token_sold_amount AS sold_amt, d.token_bought_amount AS bought_amt, d.amount_usd
  FROM dex.trades d
  LEFT JOIN v3p p ON d.version = '3' AND p.pool = d.project_contract_address
  LEFT JOIN v4s s ON d.version = '4' AND s.evt_tx_hash = d.tx_hash AND s.evt_index = d.evt_index
  LEFT JOIN v4i i ON i.id = s.id
  WHERE d.blockchain = 'ethereum' AND d.project = 'uniswap'
    AND d.block_month >= DATE '2026-09-01'
    AND d.block_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-26 20:39:32' AND d.block_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-26 20:39:32'
),
tx AS (
  SELECT tx_hash, count(*) AS n,
         array_agg(pool ORDER BY evt_index) AS pools,
         array_agg(version ORDER BY evt_index) AS versions,
         array_agg(coalesce(fee, -1) ORDER BY evt_index) AS fees,
         array_agg(coalesce(spacing, -1) ORDER BY evt_index) AS spacings,
         array_agg(sold ORDER BY evt_index) AS solds,
         array_agg(bought ORDER BY evt_index) AS boughts,
         array_agg(sold_amt ORDER BY evt_index) AS sold_amts,
         array_agg(bought_amt ORDER BY evt_index) AS bought_amts,
         array_agg(amount_usd ORDER BY evt_index) AS usds,
         max(amount_usd) AS max_usd,
         count_if(version = '4' AND (hooks IS NULL OR hooks <> 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000)) AS hooked,
         count_if(v4_weth) AS weth_v4,
         count_if(version NOT IN ('2', '3', '4') OR fee IS NULL) AS other
  FROM t GROUP BY tx_hash
),
cyc AS (
  SELECT *,
         bought_amts[n] - sold_amts[1] AS profit_tok,
         (bought_amts[n] - sold_amts[1])
           * coalesce(usds[1] / nullif(sold_amts[1], 0), usds[n] / nullif(bought_amts[n], 0)) AS profit_usd
  FROM tx
  WHERE n BETWEEN 2 AND 5
    AND solds[1] = 0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2
    AND boughts[n] = 0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2
    AND cardinality(array_distinct(pools)) = n
    AND reduce(sequence(1, n - 1), true, (s, i) -> s AND boughts[i] = solds[i + 1], s -> s)
    AND hooked = 0 AND weth_v4 = 0 AND other = 0
)
SELECT n AS legs,
       array_join(transform(solds, x -> cast(x AS varchar)), ',') AS tokens,
       array_join(versions, ',') AS versions,
       array_join(transform(pools, x -> cast(x AS varchar)), ',') AS pools,
       array_join(fees, ',') AS fees,
       array_join(spacings, ',') AS spacings,
       count(*) AS arbs,
       round(coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN profit_tok > 0 AND profit_usd <= 0.5 * max_usd THEN profit_usd END), 0), 2) AS profit_usd,
       round(coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN profit_tok > 0 AND profit_usd > 0.5 * max_usd THEN profit_usd END), 0), 2) AS suspect_usd,
       count_if(profit_tok > 0 AND profit_usd <= 0.5 * max_usd) AS clean_arbs,
       round(coalesce(approx_percentile(CASE WHEN profit_tok > 0 AND profit_usd <= 0.5 * max_usd THEN profit_usd END, 0.5), 0), 4) AS med_profit_usd,
       round(coalesce(max(CASE WHEN profit_tok > 0 AND profit_usd <= 0.5 * max_usd THEN profit_usd END), 0), 2) AS max_profit_usd
FROM cyc
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
HAVING count(*) >= 5
ORDER BY profit_usd DESC, arbs DESC
